newsitem.title: USA: Enterprise Fed to acquire North Cincinnati Savings.
newsitem.headline: Enterprise Fed to acquire North Cincinnati Savings.

text.p: Enterprise Federal Bancorp Inc has signed a definitive agreement to acquire North Cincinnati Savings Bank for $18.50 a share in cash or common stock, the companies said Monday.
North Cincinnati shareholders will have the right to elect to receive either cash, EFBI common stock, or a combination of both, they said.
However, total consideration will consist of no more than 75 percent stock or no more than 40 percent cash, they said. The deal is valued at about $7.3 million, they said.
If there is an oversubscription for either cash or EFBI stock, a pro rata distribution will be made to shareholders, they said.

The merger will be accounted for as a purchase and is expected to be completed by December 31, pending approval by North Carolina Savings' shareholders, regulatory approvals and other customary closing conditions, they said.
Enterprise Federal, the holding company for Enterprise Federal Savings Bank, operates four branch offices in Hamilton, Butler and Warren counties, Ohio.
North Carolina Savings, a state chartered savings bank, has offices in the suburban Cincinnati communities of Blue Ash and North College Hill.
